report.question: What must NOT be lost when eight architectures lose? Enumerate, per losing entry, the mechanisms that scored well on at least one rubric dimension, record why each was not carried into the winner, and classify each as PORT-NOW, PORT-LATER (with the trigger condition), or DROP (with the reason).

reviewer.scope: Confirm no minority-favoured mechanism was silently dropped. Needle: config-first minimises surprise execution.

salvage_rows.mechanism: Capability load is MANIFEST-enumerated: a file sitting in a capabilities directory is not a capability unless listed.
salvage_rows.why_not_in_winner: A2 fail-closes generated ORPHANs (unlisted_generated_file) but does not scan a live tree beside the registry. The listing rule must apply to any unreviewed file, not only generated projections.

salvage_rows.mechanism: Unlisted files are silently skipped (no fail-closed orphan signal).
salvage_rows.reason: REFUTED as min-risk: silent omit is specified, not a wording slip. Keep the listing rule; drop the silence.
salvage_rows.why_not_in_winner: Silence is the defect. Winner already names ORPHAN FAIL-CLOSED. Porting A1's silence would reintroduce the unlisted-skill omit that A2 exists to catch.

salvage_rows.mechanism: Equal load_order ties break by UTF-8 path order. No mtime, no timestamp, no runtime coin-flip.
salvage_rows.trigger: Winner (or a later overlay) allows two files with equal load_order / equal registry precedence.
salvage_rows.why_not_in_winner: A2 fail-closes duplicate registry ids and currently has no overlay files, so a path-order tie-break is unused.

salvage_rows.mechanism: Two-direction migration: a unique line on either side forbids taking the other side as a one-directional overwrite. Clocks do not authorise overwrite.
salvage_rows.why_not_in_winner: A2 extraction already queues live-larger remainder instead of opaque_body. The stronger unique-line freeze is not written as a clock-independent overwrite ban on the winner's live tree.

salvage_rows.mechanism: Smallest structural fix for two-tree drift: one writable tree. Detection-after-the-fact is not structural consistency.
salvage_rows.why_not_in_winner: A2's registry is a logical SSOT, but this host still has Direction-A orphan registry rows and zero generated files — a second implicit tree. Collapse the live writable set to the registry+generated pair.

salvage_rows.mechanism: Stop-hook after-the-fact live-vs-repo drift detector with measured both-states latency.
salvage_rows.trigger: A second live tree exists beside the registry/generated tree after PORT-NOW of A1-M5 is refused or delayed.
salvage_rows.why_not_in_winner: A2 detects drift at generate-time (TAMPERED/STALE/ORPHAN). A Stop-hook is a second sensor for a remaining live tree.

salvage_rows.mechanism: No generated layer and no resident runtime (fewest moving parts).
salvage_rows.reason: REFUTED as min-risk: no_generated_layer removes the orphan detector. Do not rebuild A2 into A1.
salvage_rows.why_not_in_winner: Absence of a generator is absence of the completeness detector. Porting 'no generator' into A2 is an ADV rebuild circle.

salvage_rows.mechanism: Config-first minimises surprise execution of unreviewed files (activation risk), not surprise absence (omission risk).
salvage_rows.why_not_in_winner: A2 ORPHAN fail-closes generated projections. The dissent extends the same rule to any unreviewed file in a live tree, including non-generated drops the registry never named.

salvage_rows.mechanism: No field-level merge. Replacement is whole-object. Field merge would be a generator.
salvage_rows.why_not_in_winner: Already present: A2 merge rule discards hand-edits on regenerate.
